about: Lane E2-P-SUB, at its rebase onto rb-main caacf05c1: lane E2-P-PHOTO's TurnRun::ask calls itself once when the provider refused the turn's photos (plain_engine.cpp ask, photosRefused); no row declared it, so the gate failed on every engine-2 image from that merge on. Declared here with its real bound, counted twice.

recursion.why: plain_engine.cpp TurnRun::ask: it calls itself only when photosRefused() answers true, which sets t_.photoRefusalResent first and answers false whenever it is already set, so the second ask never calls a third
